data.description:
# Add offline diff-phase coverage for refresh_scoped_snapshot wiring

## Problem
The live DC lane catches the f449 bug, but replacing the `run_differs.py` diff-phase `refresh_scoped_snapshot(ctx)` call with a no-op survives the offline `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` suite. The overlay behavior has coverage; its wiring into the diff phase does not.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An offline regression test fails if `run_differs.py` stops invoking `refresh_scoped_snapshot(ctx)` during the diff phase.
- [ ] The test uses existing offline fixtures/fakes and does not require the live Jira DC lane.
- [ ] The targeted offline reconciler tests pass with the real `refresh_scoped_snapshot` wiring intact.
data.title: Add offline diff-phase coverage for refresh_scoped_snapshot wiring
